'''Gamma Squadron''' was an elite bomber wing in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The squadron's starfighters bore two white stripes on both sides of each wing panel.

==History==
[[File:Captain_Jonus_XWM.png|left|thumb|Gamma Squadron on a bombing run]]
The unit was known to have fought under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Battle of Mylok IV|Conflict at Mylok IV]], along side ace [[TIE pilot]] [[Maarek Stele]].

[[Tomax Bren/Legends|Tomax Bren]] and [[Jonus]] had also been former members of the unit.

==Characteristics==
The [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] of Gamma Squadron had enhanced maneuverability to better equip them to strike capital ships while avoiding small fighter resistance.
